title: ADVANCED FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
description: Covers capital market theory and the valuation of risky assets, capital budgeting, valuing the firm's securities, capital structure theory, long-term financing alternatives, cost of capital, dividend policy, working capital management, financial analysis and planning, mergers, and takeovers.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 240, 240H, 360, 360H, ECON 350 or ENGR 390.
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 240, BA 240H, BA 360, BA 360H, ECON 350 and ENGR 390.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Finance (182), Business Engineering (355) or Finance (813).
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
